bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small bag to most Turf Club shows. Large bags, including messenger bags and backpacks, must be left at coat check, and checking bags at Turf Club is free.
prohibited: Large bags, messenger bags and backpacks (must be checked)
bagPolicy.quote: You may bring a small bag with you to most of our shows. Large bags, including messenger bags and backpacks, must be left at coat check.

parking.summary: Turf Club has a community parking lot behind the building, plus limited residential parking behind and near the venue. The lot isn't owned or monitored by Turf Club.
parking.quote: The Turf Club has a community parking lot behind the building and limited residential parking behind and near the venue.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Turf Club. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Turf Club's kitchen serves food during shows, starting as soon as doors open. The Clown Lounge downstairs also serves food and drink and opens 90 minutes before listed door times.
concessions.quote: The Turf Club's kitchen offers food service during shows, available starting as soon as doors are open for events.

accessibility.summary: All First Avenue venues, including Turf Club, are wheelchair accessible. To arrange accommodations, email info@first-avenue.com Monday through Friday, 10AM to 6PM, at least 24 hours before the show, or by 5PM Friday for weekend shows. If email doesn't work for you, call (612) 338-8388.
accessibility.quote: All venues owned and operated by First Avenue are wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.summary: Turf Club hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: AXS Mobile ID in the AXS app is the main form of entry, and will call is available for most events if you don't have a smartphone. You need a valid photo ID to enter and to claim will call tickets. No one under 21 can attend 21+ events at Turf Club, with no exceptions.
ticketPickup.quote: Persons under the age of 21 may not attend 21+ events at the Turf Club. No Exceptions.

gates.summary: Turf Club is at 1601 University Ave in St. Paul. Door times are listed on each event, and the downstairs Clown Lounge opens 90 minutes before the listed door time.
gates.quote: opens 90 minutes prior to listed door times
